purpose: 動物園バックヤード横断マップ（4章ホットスポットの台紙）: 保育室・診察室・餌の調理場・展示場
scene: One diorama of a Japanese zoo's backyard area: LEFT a small nursery room seen through a big window (warm lamp, a tiny incubator crib, a growth chart poster WITHOUT readable text), CENTER-LEFT a small veterinary exam room (window view: scale, stethoscope on a table), CENTER-RIGHT a feed kitchen (counter with vegetable baskets, bamboo bundle, hanging ladles), RIGHT an outdoor exhibit yard for a red panda with a climbing tree, a small wooden hide-box, and a low visitor fence at a respectful distance. A little path connects all four. NO animals visible except a tiny red panda tail peeking from the hide-box (cute hint).
composition: Slight top-down diorama (toy model feel), four zones evenly spaced left-to-right for UI hotspots, generous margins, nothing important near edges. Bright, warm, calm.
required_objects: feed kitchen with bamboo and vegetables
outdoor exhibit with climbing tree and hide-box
low visitor fence far from the exhibit
